30.s_dismas: after which ſhal folowe other ſeuen yeares of ſo great ſterilitie, that al the abundance before ſhal be forgotten: for the famine shal conſume al the land,
30.odr_com: after which shal folowe other seuen yeares of so great sterilitie, that al the abundance before shal be forgotten: for the famine shal consume al the land,
30.sabates_a: after which shall follow other seven years of so great sterility, that all the abundance before shall be forgotten: for the famine shall consume all the land,
30.madueke_b: after which shall follow other seven years of so great sterility, that all the abundance before shall be forgotten: for the famine shall consume all the land,

31.s_dismas: and the greatnes of the ſcarſitie, shal deſtroy the greatnes of the plentie.
31.odr_com: and the greatnes of the scarsitie, shal destroy the greatnes of the plentie.
31.sabates_a: and the greatness of the scarcity shall destroy the greatness of the plenty.
31.madueke_b: and the greatness of the scarcity shall destroy the greatness of the plenty.

32.s_dismas: And in that thou dideſt ſee the ſecond time a dreame perteining to the ſame thing: it is a token of the certeintie, for that the worde of God shal come to paſſe, and be fulfilled ſpedely.
32.odr_com: And in that thou didest see the second time a dreame perteining to the same thing: it is a token of the certeintie, for that the worde of God shal come to passe, and be fulfilled spedely.
32.sabates_a: And in that thou didst see the second time a dream pertaining to the same thing, it is a token of the certainty for that the word of God shall come to pass, and be fulfilled speedily.
32.madueke_b: And in that thou didst see the second time a dream pertaining to the same thing, it is a token of the certainty for that the word of God shall come to pass, and be fulfilled speedily.

33.s_dismas: Now therfore let the king prouide a wiſe man and induſtrious, and make him ruler ouer the Land of Ægypt:
33.odr_com: Now therfore let the king prouide a wise man and industrious, and make him ruler ouer the Land of Ægypt:
33.sabates_a: Now therefore let the king provide a wise man and industrious, & make him Ruler over the Land of Ægypt:
33.madueke_b: Now therefore let the king provide a wise man and industrious, & make him Ruler over the Land of Aegypt:

34.s_dismas: that he may appointe ouerſeers ouer al countries: and gether into barnes the fifth part of the fruites, during the ſeuen yeares of the fertilitie,
34.odr_com: that he may appointe ouerseers ouer al countries: and gether into barnes the fifth part of the fruites, during the seuen yeares of the fertilitie,
34.sabates_a: that he may appoint overseers over all countries: and gather into barns the fifth part of the fruits, during the seven years of the fertility,
34.madueke_b: that he may appoint overseers over all countries: and gather into barns the fifth part of the fruits, during the seven years of the fertility,

35.s_dismas: that now preſently shal enſewe: and let al the corne be laid vp, vnder Pharaoes handes, and let it be reſerued in the cities.
35.odr_com: that now presently shal ensewe: and let al the corne be laid vp, vnder Pharaoes handes, and let it be reserued in the cities.
35.sabates_a: that now presently shall ensue: and let all the corn be laid up under Pharao's hands, and let it be reserved in the cities.
35.madueke_b: that now presently shall ensue: and let all the corn be laid up under Pharao's hands, and let it be reserved in the cities.

36.s_dismas: And let it be in a readines, againſt the famine of ſeuen yeares to come, which shal oppreſſe Ægypt, and the land shal not be conſumed with ſcarſitie.
36.odr_com: And let it be in a readines, against the famine of seuen yeares to come, which shal oppresse Ægypt, and the land shal not be consumed with scarsitie.
36.sabates_a: And let it be in a readiness against the famine of seven years to come, which shall oppress Ægypt, and the land shall not be consumed with scarcity.
36.madueke_b: And let it be in a readiness against the famine of seven years to come, which shall oppress Aegypt, and the land shall not be consumed with scarcity.

37.s_dismas: The counſel pleaſed Pharao, and al his ſeruants:
37.odr_com: The counsel pleased Pharao, and al his seruants:
37.sabates_a: The counsel pleased Pharao, and all his servants:
37.madueke_b: The counsel pleased Pharao, and all his servants:

38.s_dismas: and he ſpake to them: Can we find ſuch an other man, that is ful of the ſpirite of God?
38.odr_com: and he spake to them: Can we find such an other man, that is ful of the spirite of God?
38.sabates_a: and he spake to them: Can we find such another man, that is full of the spirit of God?
38.madueke_b: and he spake to them: Can we find such another man, that is full of the spirit of God?

39.s_dismas: He ſaid therfore to Ioſeph: Becauſe God hath shewed thee al things that thou haſt ſpoken, can I find a wiſer and one like vnto thee?
39.odr_com: He said therfore to Ioseph: Because God hath shewed thee al things that thou hast spoken, can I find a wiser and one like vnto thee?
39.sabates_a: He said therefore to Joseph: Because God hath shewed thee all things that thou hast spoken, can I find a wiser and one like unto thee?
39.madueke_b: He said therefore to Joseph: Because God hath shewed thee all things that thou hast spoken, can I find a wiser and one like unto thee?

40.s_dismas: Thou shalt be ouer my houſe, and at the commandment of thy mouth al the people shal obey: only in the throne of the kingdome I wil goe before thee.
40.odr_com: Thou shalt be ouer my house, and at the commandment of thy mouth al the people shal obey: only in the throne of the kingdome I wil goe before thee.
40.sabates_a: Thou shalt be over my house, & at the commandment of thy mouth all the people shall obey: only in the throne of the Kingdom I will go before thee.
40.madueke_b: Thou shalt be over my house, & at the commandment of thy mouth all the people shall obey: only in the throne of the Kingdom I will go before thee.

41.s_dismas: And againe Pharao ſaid to Ioſeph: Behold, I haue appointed thee ouer the whole land of Ægypt.
41.odr_com: And againe Pharao said to Ioseph: Behold, I haue appointed thee ouer the whole land of Ægypt.
41.sabates_a: And again Pharao said to Joseph: Behold, I have appointed thee over the whole land of Ægypt.
41.madueke_b: And again Pharao said to Joseph: Behold, I have appointed thee over the whole land of Aegypt.

42.s_dismas: And he tooke his ring from his owne hand, and gaue it into his hand: and he put vpon him a ſilke roabe, and put a chaine of gold about his necke.
42.odr_com: And he tooke his ring from his owne hand, and gaue it into his hand: and he put vpon him a silke roabe, and put a chaine of gold about his necke.
42.sabates_a: And he took his ring from his own hand, and gave it into his hand: and he put upon him a silk robe, and put a chain of gold about his neck.
42.madueke_b: And he took his ring from his own hand, and gave it into his hand: and he put upon him a silk robe, and put a chain of gold about his neck.

43.s_dismas: And he made him goe vp into his ſecond chariot, the cryer proclayming that al should bowe their knee before him, and that they should know he was made gouernour ouer the whole Land of Ægypt.
43.odr_com: And he made him goe vp into his second chariot, the cryer proclayming that al should bowe their knee before him, and that they should know he was made gouernour ouer the whole Land of Ægypt.
43.sabates_a: And he made him go up into his second chariot, the crier proclaiming that all should bow their knee before him, and that they should know he was made Governor over the whole Land of Ægypt.
43.madueke_b: And he made him go up into his second chariot, the crier proclaiming that all should bow their knee before him, and that they should know he was made Governor over the whole Land of Aegypt.

44.s_dismas: And the king ſaid to Ioſeph: I am Pharao: without thy commandment no man shal moue hand or foote in al the land of Ægypt.
44.odr_com: And the king said to Ioseph: I am Pharao: without thy commandment no man shal moue hand or foote in al the land of Ægypt.
44.sabates_a: And the king said to Joseph: I am Pharao: without thy commandment no man shall move hand or foot in all the land of Ægypt.
44.madueke_b: And the king said to Joseph: I am Pharao: without thy commandment no man shall move hand or foot in all the land of Aegypt.

45.s_dismas: And he turned his name, and called him in the Ægyptian tongue the Sauiour of the world. And he gaue him to wife Aſeneth the daughter of Putiphar prieſt of Heliopolis. Ioſeph therfore went forth to the land of Ægypt
45.odr_com: And he turned his name, and called him in the Ægyptian togue the Sauiour of the world. And he gaue him to wife Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar priest of Heliopolis. Ioseph therfore went forth to the land of Ægypt
45.sabates_a: And he turned his name, & called him in the Ægyptian tongue the Saviour of the world. And he gave him to wife Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar Priest of Heliopolis. Joseph therefore went forth to the land of Ægypt
45.madueke_b: And he turned his name, & called him in the Aegyptian tongue the Saviour of the world. And he gave him to wife Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar Priest of Heliopolis. Joseph therefore went forth to the land of Aegypt

46.s_dismas: (46 and he was thirtie yeares old when he ſtood in the ſight of king Pharao) and did circuite al the countries of Ægypt.
46.odr_com: and he was thirtie yeares old when he stood in the sight of king Pharao) and did circuite al the countries of Ægypt.
46.sabates_a: (and he was thirty years old when he stood in the sight of king Pharao) and did circuit all the countries of Ægypt.
46.madueke_b: (and he was thirty years old when he stood in the sight of king Pharao) and did circuit all the countries of Aegypt.

47.s_dismas: And the fertilitie of the ſeuen yeares came: and the corne being bound vp into ſheaues was gethered togeather into the barnes of Ægypt.
47.odr_com: And the fertilitie of the seuen yeares came: and the corne being bound vp into sheaues was gethered togeather into the barnes of Ægypt.
47.sabates_a: And the fertility of the seven years came: and the corn being bound up into sheaves was gathered into the barns of Ægypt.
47.madueke_b: And the fertility of the seven years came: and the corn being bound up into sheaves was gathered into the barns of Aegypt.

48.s_dismas: Al the abundance alſo of graine was laid vp in euerie citie.
48.odr_com: Al the abundance also of graine was laid vp in euerie citie.
48.sabates_a: All the abundance also of grain was laid up in every city.
48.madueke_b: All the abundance also of grain was laid up in every city.

49.s_dismas: And there was ſo great abundance of wheat, that it became equal to the ſand of the ſea, and the plentie exceeded meaſure.
49.odr_com: And there was so great abundance of wheat, that it became equal to the sand of the sea, and the plentie exceeded measure.
49.sabates_a: And there was so great abundance of wheat, that it became equal to the sand of the sea, and the plenty exceeded measure.
49.madueke_b: And there was so great abundance of wheat, that it became equal to the sand of the sea, and the plenty exceeded measure.

50.s_dismas: And there were borne vnto Ioſeph two ſonnes before the famine came: whom Aſeneth the daughter of Putiphar prieſt of Heliopolis bare him.
50.odr_com: And there were borne vnto Ioseph two sonnes before the famine came: whom Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar priest of Heliopolis bare him.
50.sabates_a: And there were born unto Joseph two sons before the famine came: whom Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar Priest of Heliopolis bare him.
50.madueke_b: And there were born unto Joseph two sons before the famine came: whom Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar Priest of Heliopolis bare him.

51.s_dismas: And he called the name of the firſt beObliuion. gotten Manaſſes, ſaing: God made me to forget al my labours, & my fathers houſe.
51.odr_com: And he called the name of the first begotten Manasses, saing: God made me to forget al my labours, & my fathers house.
51.sabates_a: And he called the name of the first-begotten Manasses, saying: God made me to forget all my labours, and my father's house.
51.madueke_b: And he called the name of the first-begotten Manasses, saying: God made me to forget all my labours, and my father's house.

52.s_dismas: The name alſo of the ſecond he called Ephraim, ſaing: God hath made me to encreaſe in the land of my pouertie.
52.odr_com: The name also of the second he called Ephraim, saing: God hath made me to encrease in the land of my pouertie.
52.sabates_a: The name also of the second he called Ephraim, saying: God hath made me to increase in the land of my poverty.
52.madueke_b: The name also of the second he called Ephraim, saying: God hath made me to increase in the land of my poverty.

53.s_dismas: Therfore when the ſeuen yeares of the plentifulnes, that had bene in Ægypt were paſſed:
53.odr_com: Therfore when the seuen yeares of the plentifulnes, that had bene in Ægypt were passed:
53.sabates_a: Therefore when the seven years of the plentifulness, that had been in Ægypt were passed:
53.madueke_b: Therefore when the seven years of the plentifulness, that had been in Aegypt were passed:

54.s_dismas: the ſeuen yeares of ſcarcitie beganne to come, which Ioſeph foretold: and in the whole world the famine preuailed, but in al the land of Ægypt there was bread.
54.odr_com: the seuen yeares of scarsitie beganne to come, which Ioseph foretold: and in the whole world the famine preuailed, but in al the land of Ægypt there was bread.
54.sabates_a: the seven years of scarcity began to come, which Joseph foretold: and in the whole world the famine prevailed, but in all the land of Ægypt there was bread.
54.madueke_b: the seven years of scarcity began to come, which Joseph foretold: and in the whole world the famine prevailed, but in all the land of Aegypt there was bread.

55.s_dismas: The which being in hunger, the people cried to Pharao, deſiring foode. To whom he anſwered: Goe ye to Ioſeph: and whatſoeuer he ſhal ſay to you, that doe ye.
55.odr_com: The which being in hunger, the people cried to Pharao, desiring foode. To whom he answered: Goe ye to Ioseph: and whatsoeuer he shal say to you, that doe ye.
55.sabates_a: The which being in hunger, the people cried to Pharao, desiring food. To whom he answered: Go ye to Joseph: & whatsoever he shall say to you, that do ye.
55.madueke_b: The which being in hunger, the people cried to Pharao, desiring food. To whom he answered: Go ye to Joseph: & whatsoever he shall say to you, that do ye.

56.s_dismas: And the famine dayly encreaſed in al the land: and Ioſeph opened al the barnes, and ſold to the Ægyptians: for them alſo the famine had opreſſed.
56.odr_com: And the famine dayly encreased in al the land: and Ioseph opened al the barnes, and sold to the Ægyptians: for them also the famine had opressed.
56.sabates_a: And the famine daily increased in all the land: and Joseph opened all the barns, and sold to the Ægyptians: for them also the famine had oppressed.
56.madueke_b: And the famine daily increased in all the land: and Joseph opened all the barns, and sold to the Aegyptians: for them also the famine had oppressed.

57.s_dismas: And al prouinces came into Ægypt, to buy victuales, and to moderate the miſerie of the ſcarſitie.
57.odr_com: And al prouinces came into Ægypt, to buy victuales, and to moderate the miserie of the scarsitie.
57.sabates_a: And all Provinces came into Ægypt, to buy victuals, and to moderate the misery of the scarcity.
57.madueke_b: And all Provinces came into Aegypt, to buy victuals, and to moderate the misery of the scarcity.

janvier_by_verse.1: After two years Pharao saw a dream. He thought he stood upon a river,
janvier_by_verse.2: out of the which came up seven kine, fair and fat exceedingly: and they fed in marish places.
janvier_by_verse.3: Other seven also came up out of the river, foul, and carrion lean: and they fed on the very bank of the river, in green places:
janvier_by_verse.4: and they devoured them that had the marvelous beauty and good state of bodies. Pharao after he waked,
janvier_by_verse.5: slept again, and saw another dream: Seven ears of corn grew forth upon one stalk full and fair:
janvier_by_verse.6: there sprang also other ears as many, thin and blasted with adustion,
janvier_by_verse.7: devouring all the beauty of the former. Pharao awaking up after his rest,
janvier_by_verse.8: and when morning was come being frighted with fear, he sent to all the interpreters of Ægypt, and to all the wise men: and they being called for, told them his dream, neither was there any that could interpret it.
janvier_by_verse.9: Then at length the master of the cup-bearers remembering himself, said: I confess my sin:
janvier_by_verse.10: The king being angry with his servants, commanded me and the chief of the bakers to be cast into the prison of the Captain of the soldiers:
janvier_by_verse.11: where in one night both of us saw a dream portending things to come.
janvier_by_verse.12: There was there a young man an Hebrew, servant to the same Captain of the soldiers, to whom telling our dreams,
janvier_by_verse.13: we heard whatsoever afterward the event of the thing proved to be so. For I was restored to my office, and he was hanged upon a gibbet.
janvier_by_verse.14: Forthwith at the king's commandment, Joseph being brought out of the prison they polled him: and changing his apparel, brought him unto him.
janvier_by_verse.15: To whom he said: I have seen dreams, and there is not any that can expound them; which I have heard, thou dost most wisely interpret.
janvier_by_verse.16: Joseph answered: Without me, God shall answer prosperous things to Pharao.
janvier_by_verse.17: Pharao therefore told that he had see: Me thought I stood upon the bank of the river,
janvier_by_verse.18: and seven kine came up out of the bank of the river, exceeding fair, and full of flesh: which grazed on green places in a marish pasture.
janvier_by_verse.19: And behold there followed these other seven kine, so passing ill favoured and lean, that I never saw the like in the land of Ægypt;
janvier_by_verse.20: which having devoured and consumed the former,
janvier_by_verse.21: gave no token of their fullness: but with the like leanness & deformity looked heavily. Awaking, and fallen again into a deep sleep,
janvier_by_verse.22: Isaw a dream: Seven ears of corn grew forth upon one stalk, full and very fair.
janvier_by_verse.23: Other seven also thin and blasted with adustion, sprang of the stalk,
janvier_by_verse.24: which devoured the beauty of the former: I told the dream to the conjecturers, and there is no man that can declare it.
janvier_by_verse.25: Joseph answered: The king's dream is one: God hath shewed to Pharao the things that he will do.
janvier_by_verse.26: The seven fair kine, and the seven full ears, be seven years of plentifulness and both contain the self-same meaning of the dream.
janvier_by_verse.27: Also the seven lean and thin kine, that came up after them, and the seven thin ears, and blasted with the burning wind, are seven years of famine to come.
janvier_by_verse.28: Which shall be fulfilled in this order.
janvier_by_verse.29: Behold there shall come seven years of great fertility in the whole Land of Ægypt:
janvier_by_verse.30: after which shall follow other seven years of so great sterility, that all the abundance before shall be forgotten: for the famine shall consume all the land,
janvier_by_verse.31: and the greatness of the scarcity shall destroy the greatness of the plenty.
janvier_by_verse.32: And in that thou didst see the second time a dream pertaining to the same thing, it is a token of the certainty for that the word of God shall come to pass, and be fulfilled speedily.
janvier_by_verse.33: Now therefore let the king provide a wise man and industrious, & make him Ruler over the Land of Ægypt:
janvier_by_verse.34: that he may appoint overseers over all countries: and gather into barns the fifth part of the fruits, during the seven years of the fertility,
janvier_by_verse.35: that now presently shall ensue: and let all the corn be laid up under Pharao's hands, and let it be reserved in the cities.
janvier_by_verse.36: And let it be in a readiness against the famine of seven years to come, which shall oppress Ægypt, and the land shall not be consumed with scarcity.
janvier_by_verse.37: The counsel pleased Pharao, and all his servants:
janvier_by_verse.38: and he spake to them: Can we find such another man, that is full of the spirit of God?
janvier_by_verse.39: He said therefore to Joseph: Because God hath shewed thee all things that thou hast spoken, can I find a wiser and one like unto thee?
janvier_by_verse.40: Thou shalt be over my house, & at the commandment of thy mouth all the people shall obey: only in the throne of the Kingdom I will go before thee.
janvier_by_verse.41: And again Pharao said to Joseph: Behold, I have appointed thee over the whole land of Ægypt.
janvier_by_verse.42: And he took his ring from his own hand, and gave it into his hand: and he put upon him a silk robe, and put a chain of gold about his neck.
janvier_by_verse.43: And he made him go up into his second chariot, the crier proclaiming that all should bow their knee before him, and that they should know he was made Governor over the whole Land of Ægypt.
janvier_by_verse.44: And the king said to Joseph: I am Pharao: without thy commandment no man shall move hand or foot in all the land of Ægypt.
janvier_by_verse.45: And he turned his name, & called him in the Ægyptian tongue the Saviour of the world. And he gave him to wife Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar Priest of Heliopolis. Joseph therefore went forth to the land of Ægypt
janvier_by_verse.46: (and he was thirty years old when he stood in the sight of king Pharao) and did circuit all the countries of Ægypt.
janvier_by_verse.47: And the fertility of the seven years came: and the corn being bound up into sheaves was gathered into the barns of Ægypt.
janvier_by_verse.48: All the abundance also of grain was laid up in every city.
janvier_by_verse.49: And there was so great abundance of wheat, that it became equal to the sand of the sea, and the plenty exceeded measure.
janvier_by_verse.50: And there were born unto Joseph two sons before the famine came: whom Aseneth the daughter of Putiphar Priest of Heliopolis bare him.
janvier_by_verse.51: And he called the name of the first-begotten Manasses, saying: God made me to forget all my labours, and my father's house.
janvier_by_verse.52: The name also of the second he called Ephraim, saying: God hath made me to increase in the land of my poverty.
janvier_by_verse.53: Therefore when the seven years of the plentifulness, that had been in Ægypt were passed:
janvier_by_verse.54: the seven years of scarcity began to come, which Joseph foretold: and in the whole world the famine prevailed, but in all the land of Ægypt there was bread.
janvier_by_verse.55: The which being in hunger, the people cried to Pharao, desiring food. To whom he answered: Go ye to Joseph: & whatsoever he shall say to you, that do ye.
janvier_by_verse.56: And the famine daily increased in all the land: and Joseph opened all the barns, and sold to the Ægyptians: for them also the famine had oppressed.
janvier_by_verse.57: And all Provinces came into Ægypt, to buy victuals, and to moderate the misery of the scarcity.
